name: potopda
description: potopda — a minimal, self-hosted vault for your images and files. Metadata lives in MongoDB, binary data lives in Cloudinary. Frontend is a React SPA talking to a JSON API, with Socket.IO for live notifications.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
